title: 東海道新幹線
summary: 以東海道新幹線的成熟高速走廊為背景，建立服務密度高且有快慢停站差異的教學班表。將空氣阻力、受電弓、制動及車輛懸吊與運能相連，檢查提高速度後是否反而減少維護或恢復裕度。
summaryEn: Use the mature Tokaido corridor to construct a dense high-speed timetable with different stopping patterns. Connect aerodynamic resistance, current collection, braking and suspension to delivered capacity. Investigate whether raising speed consumes maintenance or recovery margins, and require an explicit distinction between historical project facts and the invented vehicle parameters used in the exercises.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率與接觸線張力波速
stages.titleEn: Aerodynamic drag and traction power & Contact-wire tension wave speed
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「空氣阻力與牽引功率」與「接觸線張力波速」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Aerodynamic drag and traction power" and "Contact-wire tension wave speed": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic drag and traction power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「空氣阻力與牽引功率」如何影響東海道新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokaido Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高速列車的空氣阻力與速度平方成正比，而克服此阻力所需功率再乘一次速度，形成三次方敏感度。有效阻力面積包含外形與附屬物影響；會車、隧道及側風會使定常自由場模型失效。 阻力是速度平方關係，而牽引功率還要乘一次速度。把逆風納入時應使用相對空氣速度；滾動阻力與坡度功率是另外的能量途徑，不能被此氣動項取代。 比較速度提升帶來的空氣阻力功率與節省的行車時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「空氣阻力與牽引功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Aerodynamic drag scales with speed squared, and the power needed to overcome it adds another speed factor. Effective drag area includes shape and attachments. Passing trains, tunnels and crosswinds can invalidate the steady open-air approximation even when the nominal speed remains unchanged. Drag varies with squared speed, while traction power introduces another speed factor. Headwind requires relative air speed. Rolling resistance and gradient power are separate energy paths and cannot be replaced by this aerodynamic term. Compare aerodynamic power growth with the running time saved by a higher speed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=73.5 m/s；計算：power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2382.392 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=73.5 m/s; calculation: power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2382.392 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「空氣阻力與牽引功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Aerodynamic drag and traction power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic drag and traction power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空氣阻力與牽引功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=73.5 m/s；計算：power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2382.392 kW。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 80.85 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 3170.964 kW。模型邊界：定常靜風且阻力面積固定；僅空氣阻力功率，不含輪軌阻力與效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=73.5 m/s; calculation: power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2382.392 kW. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 80.85 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 3170.964 kW. Model boundary: Steady still air and constant drag area; aerodynamic power only, excluding rolling resistance and conversion losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同編組與天候下做不同速度的惰行分析，記錄風速方向與車頭迎角，避免把坡度造成的加速度誤判成空阻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare coast-down observations across speeds with the same consist, log wind speed and direction, and separate gradient acceleration from aerodynamic resistance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic drag and traction power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「空氣阻力與牽引功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在相同編組與天候下做不同速度的惰行分析，記錄風速方向與車頭迎角，避免把坡度造成的加速度誤判成空阻。 同步紀錄風向風速與地速，將穩速段牽引功率扣除可辨識的坡度和輔助負載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare coast-down observations across speeds with the same consist, log wind speed and direction, and separate gradient acceleration from aerodynamic resistance. Record wind vector and ground speed together, then remove identifiable gradient and auxiliary loads from steady-running traction power. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對速度增加一成與阻力面積減少一成各算一次，對比功率節省，並把輪軌阻力另列以避免誇大整列節能比例。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate a ten percent speed increase and a ten percent drag-area reduction separately, compare power changes, and keep rolling resistance separate from whole-train energy savings. Also recalculate power for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：車底設備改變或側風會改變有效阻力面積；若只以單一速度校準，仍可能在另一速度得到錯誤牽引需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Underbody changes and crosswinds alter effective drag area; fitting one speed can still produce a wrong traction requirement at another speed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic drag and traction power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「空氣阻力與牽引功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 車底設備改變或側風會改變有效阻力面積；若只以單一速度校準，仍可能在另一速度得到錯誤牽引需求。 需核對風向，避免把順風和逆風的相對速度互換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「延遲與制動距離」如何影響東海道新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Delay and braking distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokaido Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車在控制命令傳遞與煞車建立期間仍向前行駛，減速段才把動能耗散；因此停車距離包含延遲距離與減速距離。速度平方項說明高速時少量速度誤差會被放大，固定減速度只能作第一輪界限估算。 延遲項與速度成正比，減速項與速度平方成正比；把兩項分開後，才能選擇改善控制延遲或增加有效制動的方案。若存在坡度，應另加沿坡重力，不能只改總距離。 檢查高速進站前的速度誤差如何放大停車位置誤差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「延遲與制動距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds. Only the deceleration phase removes kinetic energy, so stopping distance includes both a delay term and a braking term. The squared speed dependence amplifies speed uncertainty; constant deceleration is only an initial bounding approximation. The delay term is linear in speed and the deceleration term is quadratic. Separating them reveals whether control latency or effective braking deserves attention. A gradient requires an added gravitational component, not an arbitrary adjustment to the final distance. Examine how speed error before a high-speed approach magnifies stopping-position error. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Delay and braking distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 彈簧與質量的組合決定垂向固有頻率，增加質量降低頻率而提高剛度使頻率升高。軌道不平順被車速轉換成時間激振；因此相同軌道波長在不同速度下可能接近或遠離共振。 固有頻率和振幅不是同一資訊，阻尼主要影響峰值和衰減。空車與滿載質量不同時，軌道某一波長可能落在不同激振頻率比，應同時考慮速度與載重。 將同一軌道波長轉成不同速度下的懸吊激振頻率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「懸吊固有頻率與激振」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Spring stiffness and supported mass determine vertical natural frequency. Added mass lowers frequency, while increased stiffness raises it. Train speed converts spatial track irregularity into temporal excitation, so the same wavelength may approach or leave resonance as speed changes. Natural frequency and amplitude contain different information; damping primarily affects peaks and decay. Empty and loaded masses can place one track wavelength at different excitation-frequency ratios. Speed and loading therefore need to be considered together. steps.title: 懸吊固有頻率與激振：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「懸吊固有頻率與激振」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Suspension frequency and excitation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：k=900000 N/m; mass=12600 kg；計算：frequency=(k/mass)**0.5/(2*3.141592653589793)=1.345105 Hz。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 13860 kg，其餘固定，結果為 1.282507 Hz。模型邊界：單自由度無阻尼模型；不含俯仰、側滾與輪軌接觸。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: k=900000 N/m; mass=12600 kg; calculation: frequency=(k/mass)**0.5/(2*3.141592653589793)=1.345105 Hz. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 13860 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.282507 Hz. Model boundary: Undamped single-degree-of-freedom model; pitch, roll and wheel-rail contact are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測已知質量下的自由衰減與頻率響應，對照不同載客狀態；同步記錄軌道波長和速度，避免混淆激振頻率與固有頻率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure free decay and frequency response at known mass, repeat for different passenger loading, and log track wavelength and speed to distinguish excitation from natural frequency.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 懸吊固有頻率與激振：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Suspension frequency and excitation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「懸吊固有頻率與激振」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Suspension frequency and excitation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測已知質量下的自由衰減與頻率響應，對照不同載客狀態；同步記錄軌道波長和速度，避免混淆激振頻率與固有頻率。 由自由衰減同時辨識頻率及衰減率，檢查感測器是否位於同一振型的有效位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure free decay and frequency response at known mass, repeat for different passenger loading, and log track wavelength and speed to distinguish excitation from natural frequency. Identify frequency and decay rate together from free decay, and verify that sensors occupy useful positions for the same vibration mode. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare empty and loaded frequencies, calculate the speed corresponding to one irregularity wavelength, and explain the influence of damping and suspension travel limits. Also recalculate frequency for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只調剛度追求低頻隔振可能增加行程需求；阻尼器失效可能保持固有頻率近似不變，卻大幅增加共振振幅。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Softening springs for low-frequency isolation increases travel demand; a failed damper may barely change natural frequency while greatly increasing resonant amplitude. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「快慢車追及與待避」如何影響東海道新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fast-slow train catch-up” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokaido Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。這個簡單關係能辨認待避需求，但實際時刻表還需加入停站、進路鎖閉與加減速；追及點不是允許兩車接近的安全距離。 追趕時間取決於起始間隔和兩列相對速度，不能只看快車速度。若兩列會停站或受訊號限制，速度必須改成分段函數，並把進路占用放回事件圖。 在不停站與多停站列車之間追蹤追趕與待避時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「快慢車追及與待避」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. steps.title: 班距與有效運能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「班距與有效運能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Headway and usable capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=189 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17142.86 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 207.9 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 15584.42 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=189 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17142.86 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 207.9 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15584.42 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「班距與有效運能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Headway and usable capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「班距與有效運能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Headway and usable capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對高密度班表保留逐列負載，避免只看小時平均。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Retain individual train loads in a dense timetable rather than only an hourly average.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」如何影響東海道新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokaido Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由鋼軌升溫會伸長，完全拘束的理想鋼軌則把熱應變轉成壓應力。鎖定軌溫決定應力零點而空氣溫度不等於鋼軌溫度；實際扣件滑移與軌道側向阻力還會改變穩定問題。 溫差應相對於鋼軌實際無應力狀態，而非任意室溫。完全拘束估算給出軸向應力尺度；當扣件滑移或軌道彎曲出現時，需要位移相容和側向穩定分析。 比較曝曬軌段和維修後鎖定軌段的熱應力零點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A free rail expands on heating, while an ideally restrained rail converts thermal strain into compression. Stress-free rail temperature defines the reference and differs from air temperature. Fastener slip and lateral track resistance additionally govern stability, beyond the one-dimensional thermal-stress estimate. Temperature change must reference the rail’s actual stress-free state, not an arbitrary room temperature. Full restraint gives an axial stress scale. Fastener slip or track curvature requires displacement compatibility and lateral stability analysis beyond this expression. Compare the thermal-stress reference for exposed track and track after maintenance locking. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=31.5 K；計算：compression=E*alpha*deltaT=76.0725 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=31.5 K; calculation: compression=E*alpha*deltaT=76.0725 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可用度與修復時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Availability and repair time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用度與修復時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Availability and repair time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將列車故障修復與檢修窗口分開，檢查服務可用性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate fault repair from maintenance windows when examining delivered service availability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
